**EL-RSP-1.4.1 Forward to LIN within 5 ms**

RLCM_Lighting shall write ReqLeft and ReqRight of DEVMLIN01Fr01 within 5 ms of receiving the TurnLightControl frame, so that the next scheduled DEVMLIN01Fr01 slot carries them.

description: Obligation of RLCM_Lighting as RLCM in RearLight (EL-RSP-1.4.1).

Realized by ImplementedRLCM_Lighting: on_turn_req_frame() publishes in the frame handler itself. Handler latency is allocated to RLCM_ECU (RLCM_ECU_Lighting_Forwarding) through ComputeAllocation_RLCM_Lighting; the slot gap to RearLightLIN (RearLightLIN_TurnRequest_Schedule) through CommunicateAllocation_RearLightLIN.
